letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Each sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful, dual‑world with you.  From the glittering skyline to the fragrant spice markets, your smile turns every moment into magic.  I love the way you laugh, the way you care, and the way our hearts sync across continents.  Today feels like another page in our endless love story—just another excuse to tell you how deeply, playfully, and endlessly I adore you.
poem:
Across the dunes and mango trees we roam,  
Your hand in mine feels always like home.  
With every sunset, love’s colors blend,  
My heart, dear Liza, beats till the end.
